## AniSequel

Find the anime sequels you finished the first season of and never got
around to, and add them to your AniList Planning list in one tap.

### 📦 APK package
**anisequel-universal.apk** runs on every supported device — there is
only one build, so there is nothing to choose between.

*Built from commit* `07fdb7786d085119a1ae5fffb09d01f1006d1264` *on run* `32`.

### 🔑 First launch
AniSequel signs you in to your own AniList account through AniList's
OAuth page — there is no AniSequel account and no password to manage.

### ⚠️ Installing over an older build
Every release is signed with the same key, so you can install this over
any previous version without uninstalling first.

If Android reports **"App not installed as package conflicts"**, an
older copy signed with a *different* key is still present. Uninstall
**AniSequel** once, then install this APK.

### 🛡️ "App blocked to protect your device"

Store and is signed by an unrecognised developer. This is expected
